## 1. USER AUTHENTICATION

| Story ID | Title | Description | Story Points | Priority |
|----------|-------|-------------|--------------|----------|
| AUT-001 | Login Functionality | Test user login with valid/invalid credentials | 5 | P1 |
| AUT-002 | Register Functionality | Test user registration with valid/invalid data | 3 | P1 |
| AUT-003 | Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) | Test enabling and using 2FA for login | 3 | P1 |
| AUT-004 | Password Reset | Test password reset functionality | 2 | P1 |

### Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Login with valid email/password succeeds (redirect to dashboard)
- [ ] Login with invalid email/password fails (error message displayed)
- [ ] Login with locked account fails (account lock message)
- [ ] Register with valid data succeeds (confirmation email sent)
- [ ] Register with existing email fails (error message)
- [ ] Enable 2FA via SMS/Email/Authenticator app
- [ ] Login requires 2FA code after enabling
- [ ] Request reset link via email (link received)
- [ ] Reset password with valid link succeeds

## GROK'S SPRINT 21 RECOMMENDATIONS

### Top 5 Issues to Address:
1. **Cross-Module Integration Depth** - Finance/Logistics/HR data sync needs automation
2. **Freelancer Hub Feature Completeness** - Payment escrow, project bidding needed
3. **LMS Engagement Features** - Gamification, progress tracking needed
4. **Mobile App Offline Sync Edge Cases** - Data conflict resolution
5. **ANAF Compliance Edge Cases** - Real-time eFactura, complex VAT scenarios

### Priority Tasks for Sprint 21:
1. Enhance Cross-Module Integrations (v1.1) - **8 SP**
2. Freelancer Hub Core Features (MVP) - **13 SP**
3. LMS Engagement Features - **5 SP**
4. Mobile App Offline Sync Optimization - **8 SP**
5. ANAF Compliance for Edge Cases - **5 SP**

**Total: 39 Story Points**

---

## EXECUTION PLAN

Execute tests in this order:
1. **P1 Critical** (Authentication, Dashboard, OCR, Invoice, VAT, e-Factura, SAF-T, SAGA, HR, Payments, Mobile Offline, Accessibility, Performance)
2. **P2 Important** (Charts, Alerts, HSE, Freelancer, LMS, Logistics, E-commerce, Multi-currency, Settings, Push Notifications)
3. **P3 Nice-to-have** (Notification customization)
